name: const unsafe fn byte_offset_from < U : ? Sized > (self , origin : NonNull < U >) -> isize
rule: For safety, self and origin must either have the same data-pointer address, or both be derived from a pointer to the same allocated object with the entire memory range between their data pointers in bounds of that object. For non-Sized pointees, metadata is ignored. This requirement applies both at compile time and at runtime.
